title: Google Launches Anthropic Managed Claude Deployment on Google Cloud

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Customers on Google Cloud can now utilize an Anthropic managed deployment for Claude AI models to access the full suite of platform features. The general availability of this option allows users to integrate the models using Google Cloud identity and access management credentials and billing systems while leveraging commitment retirement.

The deployment provides access to the Claude API, including Claude Managed Agents and code execution capabilities. It also enables the use of Opus 5.5 fast mode and will include new features as they are launched.
